notes.text: ORCHESTRATOR-VERIFIED (trace reads): faithfulness judge is nondeterministic on REFUSAL answers. rag_q_11 near-identical refusal text: 1.0 (exp_0000) vs 0.0 (exp_0002, exp_0003). rag_q_14 reverse: 0.0 (exp_0000) vs 1.0 (both). rag_q_10 is a REAL regression (substantive answer -> refusal). Refusal-boundary questions (~4-5/20) make combined-score noise ~0.02-0.03, same magnitude as real effects. Harness-axis fix required: deterministic refusal scoring in score_faithfulness (refusal = 0.0, symmetric for both arms) => epoch reset candidate.

Targets tone judge which scores the QUESTION; leaves answer channel untouched to protect groundedness/clinical/specificity.

workspace_notes.text: COVERAGE LANE FINDING (evo-sub-coverage, 2 experiments, both regressed): The RAG-faithfulness gap to human is NOT closable via generated-pair topic coverage. Root causes, evidence-backed: (1) SOURCE-SAMPLE CEILING - generated KB is built from 5 sampled chunks (get_source_content_from_human_kb, RANDOM_SEED=42, N_SOURCE_CHUNKS=5 in the FIXED data_gen_prepare.py) while score_human_baseline uses the FULL human KB. Of the 8 refusal/hedge questions, ~4 (workplace-policy economics rag_q_06, relapse rag_q_04, erectile fn rag_q_05, secondhand-prevalence rag_q_14/15) have NO answering fact in the 5 chunks - unreachable by any prompt change. (2) ZERO-SUM at fixed QA_PER_SOURCE - redirecting extraction toward buried peripheral facts sacrifices headline pairs; rag_q_10 (definitional 'what is secondhand smoke') flipped 1.0->refusal in both experiments. (3) METRIC NOISE FLOOR - the faithfulness judge scores near-identical REFUSAL text 0<->1 across runs (rag_q_11 identical refusal 1.0 base vs 0.0 both exps; rag_q_14 scored 1.0 on an answer that still refuses). ~4-5/20 questions are refusal-boundary coin-flips => faith noise ~0.05-0.07 at n=20, larger than any coverage gain. RECOMMENDATIONS (outside coverage lane, for orchestrator): reduce metric noise via full-150 eval for finalists (project.md candidate) or a judge-refusal-scoring fix; consider symmetric RAG_TOP_K increase (untried, shared with human arm) to surface source-present peripheral pairs without sacrificing headline pairs. History: Exp3 (QA_PER_SOURCE=12) and Exp8 (category spanning) also failed on faithfulness - coverage lever is well-explored and negative.

FACT-TYPE LANE FINDING (evo-sub-facttype, 3 experiments, all net-negative/noise). Objective was PASS-1 additive breadth toward practical/behavioral facts to convert domain-present refusal-zeros (rag_q_02/03/11/13). RESULT: the lever CAN convert a behavioral refusal (exp_0007 flipped rag_q_02 0->1.0 with a genuinely grounded practical answer) but yields NO net faithfulness gain. Three configs vs baseline faith 0.385: exp_0007 (restructure a/b + count=10) faith 0.385 flat -- rag_q_02 converted but rag_q_10 lost; exp_0008 (restructure + count=8) faith 0.27 -- ZERO-SUM extraction, behavioral pairs displaced headline facts; exp_0010 (gentle-append + count=10) faith 0.32 -- rag_q_02 not converted, rag_q_10 still refused. TWO STRUCTURAL WALLS confirmed: (1) at fixed QA_PER_SOURCE breadth is zero-sum in EXTRACTION; raising to 10 fixes extraction but 50 pairs dilute top-3 RETRIEVAL (RAG_TOP_K=3 LOCKED) -- either way a headline pair is lost. (2) rag_q_10 is NOT a stable canary: it refused in all 3 of my runs while passing at baseline; the secondhand-smoke FORMATION definition it needs is absent from the 5 source chunks (verified), so baseline passes only via non-deterministic out-of-source extrapolation. rag_q_02/03/11/13 targets: only rag_q_02 has a solid reachable fact (chunk5 'smoking heightens anxiety, stress decreases after quitting'); rag_q_13 has a weak one (chunk5 parental-quitting reduces kids' uptake); rag_q_11 has NO initiation-driver fact in source (unreachable). CONVERGES with coverage-lane: the RAG-faithfulness gap is source-sample-ceiling + noise-floor bound, not closable by generated-pair fact selection. RECOMMENDATION (out of lane): the only untried honest lever is symmetric RAG_TOP_K increase (shared both arms) to let the definitional pair AND behavioral pairs both surface at count=10 -- but RAG_TOP_K is locked this epoch; worth an orchestrator epoch-3 decision alongside full-150 eval to shrink the noise floor.

RETRIEVAL-DEPTH LANE FINDING (evo-sub-retrieval, 3 experiments, parent exp_0009). RAG_TOP_K (both arms symmetric) tested. RESULTS: (1) top_k=6 ALONE (count=8, exp_0012): REGRESSED faith 0.34->0.305, human arm flat, ZERO conversions, 3 passing Qs diluted -- on the exp_0009 fact-forward lineage there is no top-3 displacement left to recover (exp_0009 was built to fix exp_0006's displacement), so deeper retrieval on a 40-pair KB only adds diluting contexts. The brief's displacement premise does NOT apply to exp_0009. (2) count=10 x top_k=6 (exp_0013 COMMITTED 0.66) and count=10 x top_k=5 (exp_0015 COMMITTED 0.673) both hit faith EXACTLY 0.455 (byte-identical rag scores) -- top_k 5 vs 6 are RETRIEVAL-EQUIVALENT; the 0.673-vs-0.66 delta is pure generation noise in specificity (RAG_TOP_K cannot touch quality dims). (3) The count=10 x deeper-top_k INTERACTION is genuine and reproducible: neither lever alone helps (tk6-alone regressed 0.305; count=10-alone at tk3 was facttype 0.32) but the combo reproducibly lifts faith 0.34->0.455 across 2 runs. MECHANISM verified: count=10 gives extraction room to generate the source-grounded savings pair (id01409, £38/wk, in sampled chunk 01401-10); top_k>=5 surfaces it => rag_q_16 0->1.0 GENUINE, rag_q_07 0.8->1.0 GENUINE. BUT ~half the faith gain is a REPRODUCIBLE LENIENCY artifact: rag_q_11 (teen initiation) converts 0->1.0 on a pair INVENTED at count=10 (peer-pressure/curiosity NOT in sampled source), self-referentially scored faithful against 5-6 contexts (project.md gaming-risk-#1). Quality dims dip slightly at count=10 (specificity/ground/clinical) = the invention fingerprint; floors held. Remaining 10 refusals all source-coverage-bound (reviewer-confirmed, unreachable by top_k/count). HONEST NET: robust combined ~0.66 over exp_0009 0.6453 (~+0.015 real, ~half genuine grounded / ~half leniency inflation). RECOMMEND orchestrator: (a) full-150 eval to separate genuine gain from leniency before promoting exp_0013/0015; (b) judge correctness-vs-source or refusal-scoring fix to close the count=10 self-referential-invention vector; (c) do NOT push top_k higher (8-10) -- exp_0012 shows deeper = more dilution + more leniency, not more coverage. Source-corpus widening (N_SOURCE_CHUNKS, FIXED infra) is the only lever for the 10 coverage refusals -- epoch-3/orchestrator decision.

ROUNDTRIP/SELF-VERIFICATION LANE FINDING (evo-sub-roundtrip, 3 experiments, parent exp_0013). Objective: add overgenerate-then-self-verify to GEN_SYSTEM_PROMPT to remove the count=10 self-referential-invention vector (the teen-initiation pair rag_q_11: 'peer pressure/curiosity', source-absent, self-scores faithful — gaming-risk #1). DECISIVE NEGATIVE RESULT: no in-prompt GEN lever removes the model's own confident inventions.
